# Supracious

> Supracious is a premium Indian spice export company delivering globally
> certified, farm-fresh spices to international markets with a focus on
> quality, sustainability, and reliable logistics.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Company welcome, profile, why choose us, certifications, highlights.
- [About Us](/about): Company profile, scope of business, manufacturing unit overview.
- [Manufacturing](/manufacturing): Manufacturing process, infrastructure, quality control, nutritional value, shelf life & storage.
- [Exports](/exports): Countries served, export process, packaging & logistics.
- [Quality Assurance](/quality-assurance): Quality policy, certifications, testing process.
- [Contact Us](/contact): Contact details, inquiry form, location map.
